from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

def _load(name: str, relative: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / relative)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def _readonly_result():
    return {
        "status": "READ_ONLY_COMPLETE", "tests": "PASS",
        "quality_gate": "PASS", "production_touched": False,
        "blockers": [], "percent_complete": 100,
        "checks": [{
            "type": "sql_readonly_audit", "status": "PASS",
            "sql_evidence": {
                "status": "PASS", "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
                "connection": "readonly_sql_connection:default",
                "evidence": [{
                    "name": "metadata",
                    "columns": ["object_name", "password_hash"],
                    "rows": [["Servidores_Conexiones", "must-not-publish"]],
                    "row_count_returned": 1, "truncated": false
                }]
            }
        }]
    }

def test_readonly_complete_requires_sanitizable_evidence():
    publisher = _load("publisher_readonly", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    result = _readonly_result()
    assert publisher.certification_evidence(result)["certification"] == "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"
    result["checks"] = []
    assert publisher.certification_evidence(result)["certification"] == "NOT_CERTIFIED"

def test_sensitive_columns_are_redacted_before_publication():
    publisher = _load("publisher_redaction", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    public = publisher.sanitize(_readonly_result())
    assert public["certification"] == "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"
    row = public["sql_readonly_evidence"]["checks"][0]["evidence"][0]["rows"][0]
    assert row == ["Servidores_Conexiones", "[REDACTED]"]
    assert "must-not-publish" not in json.dumps(public)

def test_readonly_marker_can_promote_not_certified(tmp_path):
    publisher = _load("publisher_marker", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    marker = tmp_path / "job.json"
    marker.write_text("certification=NOT_CERTIFIED\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert publisher.marker_satisfied(marker, {"certification": "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"}) is False
    marker.write_text("certification=CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert publisher.marker_satisfied(marker, {"certification": "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"}) is True

def test_dispatcher_preserves_structured_sql_evidence(monkeypatch):
    dispatcher = _load("dispatcher_readonly", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_dispatcher.py")
    payload = {"status": "PASS", "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL", "connection": "readonly_sql_connection:default", "evidence": [{"name": "x", "columns": ["a"], "rows": [[1]], "row_count_returned": 1, "truncated": False}]}
    monkeypatch.setattr(dispatcher, "run", lambda *args, **kwargs: subprocess.CompletedProcess(args=[], returncode=0, stdout=json.dumps(payload)))
    result = dispatcher.run_check(ROOT, {"type": "sql_readonly_audit", "queries": [{"name": "x", "sql": "SELECT 1"}]})
    assert result["status"] == "PASS"
    assert result["sql_evidence"] == payload
    assert result["output"] == "SQL_READONLY_AUDIT=PASS"
